stories.title: Dart, Daniels, Williams ... now Mayfield, too? Are we seeing more QB injuries than normal this season?
stories.summary: There have been eight QB injuries through three weeks of the NFL season, up a little bit from recent years. Is it a trend or just an outlier -- and is there a clear reason?

stories.title: Joey Porter Jr. traded: What move means for Cowboys, Steelers
stories.summary: Our insiders discuss Porter's fit in Dallas, his potential for a new contract and what's next for the Steelers.

stories.title: Steelers trade Porter to Cowboys, get pair of picks to end CB saga
stories.summary: The Steelers traded cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder.

stories.title: Source: No discipline for Aces' Wilson over fan confrontation
stories.summary: Aces star A'ja Wilson will not face any further discipline over her confrontation with a fan during Tuesday's Game 2 against the Fever, a source told ESPN.

stories.title: Red Sox's Gray 'frustrated' by lack of trust from manager in loss to Yankees
stories.summary: Red Sox ace Sonny Gray said after Wednesday's loss to the Yankees that he was frustrated for being lifted after throwing only 70 pitches.
